content.text: Hagaamu ina Dimaadua!
Ma e humalia ma ga daahili e hagaamu tadau God.
Ma koia e humalia gei e donu dela belee hagaamu a Mee.
Dimaadua e haga duu aga hoou Jerusalem.
Mee e laha mai labelaa digau Israel ala ne lahi galabudi.
Mee e hagahili nia daangada ala gu manawa gee,
gaa hii nia gowaa digaula ala e moholehole.
Go Mee dela ne haga noho di hulu heduu,
e gahi di ingoo di heduu nei mo di heduu nei.
Tadau Dagi le e aamua ge maaloo.
Di kabemee o Maa le e deemee di hagatau.
Mee e dahi aga digau ala e manawa hila gi lala,
ge e dagadagahi digau huaidu gi lodo nia gelegele.
Daahili i nia daahili hagaamu ang gi Dimaadua.
Daahili i godou ‘harp’ ang gi tadau God.
Mee e hagamodoho nia gololangi i lala di langi.
Mee e hai nia uwa gii too gi henuailala,
gaa hai nia geinga tolo gii tomo i tomo nia gonduu.
Mee e wanga nia meegai gi nia manu,
ga haangai nia manu mamaangi ‘raven’
i nadau madagoaa ma ga tangitangi hiigai.
Mee hagalee manawa tene gi nia hoodo maaloo,
be gi nia daane dauwa de mmaadagu.
Mee e manawa tene hua gi digau ala e hagalaamua Ia,
mo digau ala e hagadagadagagee gi dono aloho dee modu.
Jerusalem, hagaamuina Dimaadua! Zion, hagaamu ina doo God!
Mee e hagaloohi haga humalia nia ngudu nia bontai o dau abaaba.
Mee e haga maluagina au daangada.
Mee e madamada humalia tagageinga o do henua,
ga haangai goodou gi nia palaawaa ala koia e humalia.
Mee ga helekai gi henuailala,
gei di mee a Maa dela ne helekai ai le e gila hagalimalima.
Mee e holo nia ‘snow’ gadoo be di ‘blanket’,
ga haga nonnono nia magalillili gadoo be nia gelegele.
Mee e haga doo dana uwa hadu magalillili gadoo be nia giligili.
Deai tangada e mee di noho mahana
i lodo di magalillili ma ga hai mai go Mee ai!
Mee e helekai hua gei nia koolii gu waiwai.
Mee gaa hai di madangi gii gono, gei nia wai ga malingi.
Mee e wanga ana helekai gi ana daangada,
ana aago mo ana haganoho gi digau Israel.
Mee digi hai di mee deenei gi digau o nia henua ala i golo,
digaula e de iloo ginaadou ana haganoho.
Hagaamu ina Dimaadua!
